title: WIZ CLOUD – COMPLETE SECURITY & REMEDIATION OVERVIEW
description: Standalone combined AWS security overview, environment/category analysis and CVE/package remediation dashboard. Existing dashboards are independent and unchanged. Security overview counts OPEN Risk/Posture issues, category panels count OPEN findings, and remediation panels include OPEN plus IN_PROGRESS vulnerability findings. Environment and Wiz severity filter all finding panels; NVD CVSS severity further filters only the CVE section. No invented historical data, CI/CD counts or SLA thresholds.

list.name: environment
list.label: AWS Environment
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT subscription_name FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE cloud_platform = 'AWS' ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT subscription_name FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE cloud_platform = 'AWS' ORDER BY 1

list.name: cvss_severity
list.label: NVD CVSS Severity (CVE Section Only)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cvss_severity, 'UNKNOWN') FROM wiz_vulnerabilities ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cvss_severity, 'UNKNOWN') FROM wiz_vulnerabilities ORDER BY 1

options.content:
**AWS Environment + Wiz Severity** filter all finding panels (Critical through Low). **NVD CVSS Severity** is an additional filter for the CVE section only.

**Security Overview:** OPEN Risk/Posture issues, not individual vulnerability findings. **Categories:** OPEN records by source; categories have different granularities. **CVE & Remediation:** OPEN + IN_PROGRESS vulnerabilities. **Cloud Assets:** affected resources, not total inventory. Exposure uses rule-name matching, not verified reachability.

Current counts ignore the time picker; trend charts use actual collected snapshots in the selected time range. CI/CD remains explicitly unavailable. Remediation age is days since detection, not resolved MTTR; SLA deadlines/compliance are not calculated without targets.

panels.title: Collection Coverage & Freshness
panels.description: Global collection status, independent of filters. Failed syncs preserve the last committed data. Missing CI/CD data is not zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT category AS "Category", CASE WHEN available THEN 'Available' ELSE 'UNAVAILABLE' END AS "Coverage", last_success_at AS "Last successful collection", detail AS "Details" FROM wiz_collection_status ORDER BY category;

panels.title: SECURITY OVERVIEW — Open Risk & Posture Issues
Critical Issues
panels.description: OPEN AWS Risk/Posture issues of CRITICAL severity. Does not mix individual vulnerability findings into issue counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Critical issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND severity = 'CRITICAL' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: High Issues
panels.description: OPEN AWS Risk/Posture issues of HIGH severity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "High issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND severity = 'HIGH' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: Cloud Assets
panels.description: Distinct identified resources affected by selected OPEN AWS Risk/Posture issues. Not a count of total cloud inventory.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT resource_id) AS "Affected resources" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: Exposed Assets (Rule Matches)
panels.description: Shows both distinct identified resources and OPEN Risk/Posture issue counts where rule names contain internet, public or exposed. A rule-name heuristic, not verified exposure or complete internet-facing asset inventory.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT resource_id) AS "Assets", COUNT(*) AS "Open issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND rule_name ~* '(internet|public|exposed)' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

SELECT severity AS "Severity", COUNT(*) AS "Issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY severity ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;

panels.title: Open Issues Trend – Last 30 Days
panels.description: Risk/Posture OPEN counts by severity from actual snapshots. Default range is 30 days; changing the time picker changes this chart. No pre-collection history is fabricated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT captured_at AS "time", severity AS metric, SUM(issue_count)::double precision AS value FROM wiz_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_at) AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY captured_at, severity ORDER BY captured_at, severity;

SELECT subscription_name AS "Environment", severity AS "Severity", COUNT(*) AS "Issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY subscription_name, severity ORDER BY subscription_name, severity;

panels.title: Top Risky Resources
panels.description: Top 20 resources ranked by OPEN Critical then High Risk/Posture issue counts, within selected AWS accounts and Wiz severities.

targets.rawSql: SELECT subscription_name AS "Environment", resource_id AS "Resource ID", MAX(resource_name) AS "Resource", MAX(resource_type) AS "Type", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL') AS "Critical", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'HIGH') AS "High" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND resource_id IS NOT NULL AND severity IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH') AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY subscription_name, resource_id ORDER BY "Critical" DESC, "High" DESC, subscription_name, resource_id LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Recent Detections
panels.description: 50 most recent OPEN AWS Risk/Posture issues with actual environment, resource and rule metadata.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", CONCAT('[', severity, '] environment=', subscription_name, ' category=', category, ' resource=', COALESCE(resource_name, resource_id, '(unknown)'), ' rule=', COALESCE(NULLIF(rule_name,''), '(not supplied)')) AS body FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category IN ('Risk Issues','Posture Issues') AND created_at IS NOT NULL AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 50;

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'Vulnerability Management') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'Vulnerability Management' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'Risk Issues') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'Risk Issues' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'Posture Issues') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open issues" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'Posture Issues' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: CI/CD Scans
panels.description: Missing read:security_scans permission; unavailable data is not reported as zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT available FROM wiz_collection_status WHERE category = 'CI/CD Scans') THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND category = 'CI/CD Scans' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring});

SELECT subscription_name AS "Environment", category AS "Category", COUNT(*) AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY subscription_name, category ORDER BY subscription_name, category;

panels.title: Severity Breakdown by Category
panels.description: Critical, High and Medium OPEN findings; also respects the selected Wiz severity filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT category AS "Category", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL') AS "CRITICAL", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'HIGH') AS "HIGH", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'MEDIUM') AS "MEDIUM" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND severity IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM') GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;

panels.title: Category Trends Over Time
panels.description: Actual periodic OPEN-finding snapshots. Unavailable CI/CD and uncollected history are not filled with invented zeros.

targets.rawSql: SELECT captured_at AS "time", category AS metric, SUM(issue_count)::double precision AS value FROM wiz_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_at) AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY captured_at, category ORDER BY captured_at, category;

SELECT category || ' | ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(rule_name,''), '(unnamed)') AS "Category / Rule", COUNT(*) AS "Open findings" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY category, rule_name ORDER BY "Open findings" DESC, category, rule_name LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Filtered Findings Table
panels.description: Up to 1,000 most recent matching OPEN findings. Counts and charts cover all matching records.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Detection Date", subscription_name AS "Environment", category AS "Category", severity AS "Wiz Severity", rule_name AS "Rule", resource_name AS "Resource", resource_type AS "Resource Type" FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE is_active AND status = 'OPEN' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: CVE & REMEDIATION MANAGEMENT — Active Vulnerability Findings
Total Vulnerable Packages
panels.description: Distinct resource/package/installed-version combinations with OPEN or IN_PROGRESS findings. Missing resource IDs/package names are excluded; multiple CVEs in one installed package do not multiply the package count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (a.resource_id, v.package_name, v.installed_version)) AS "Vulnerable packages" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS') AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND a.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(v.package_name,'') IS NOT NULL AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND a.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.cvss_severity,'UNKNOWN') IN (${cvss_severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: Mean Remediation Age (Days Open)
panels.description: Finding-weighted mean days since first detection for OPEN + IN_PROGRESS vulnerabilities. Missing detection dates are excluded. Not MTTR or an SLA compliance percentage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - a.created_at)) / 86400.0)::double precision AS "Days open" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS') AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND a.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.cvss_severity,'UNKNOWN') IN (${cvss_severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: Count of Known Exploited CVEs
panels.description: Distinct active CVEs with hasCisaKevExploit=true (CISA KEV). Public exploit availability alone is not sufficient.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.cve_id) AS "Known exploited CVEs" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS') AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND v.known_exploited IS TRUE AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND a.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.cvss_severity,'UNKNOWN') IN (${cvss_severity:sqlstring});

panels.title: Top Vulnerable CVEs / Packages
panels.description: Top 15 CVE/package pairs by active finding count. Non-CVE advisories remain in the action table and package/aging metrics.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.cve_id || ' | ' || COALESCE(v.package_name,'(unknown package)') AS "CVE / Package", COUNT(*) AS "Active findings" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS') AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND v.cve_id IS NOT NULL AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND a.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.cvss_severity,'UNKNOWN') IN (${cvss_severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY v.cve_id, v.package_name ORDER BY "Active findings" DESC, v.cve_id, v.package_name LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Vulnerabilities by Asset Type
panels.description: Counts active findings, not unique assets. VM images are grouped with VMs and container images with containers. Kubernetes-managed workloads appear as containers when identified as such; no Kubernetes attribution is inferred.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN a.resource_type IN ('VIRTUAL_MACHINE','VIRTUAL_MACHINE_IMAGE') THEN 'VMs / VM Images' WHEN a.resource_type IN ('CONTAINER','CONTAINER_IMAGE') THEN 'Containers / Images' ELSE COALESCE(a.resource_type,'Unknown') END AS "Asset type", COUNT(*) AS "Findings" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS') AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND a.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.cvss_severity,'UNKNOWN') IN (${cvss_severity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Findings" DESC, "Asset type";

panels.title: Remediation Action Table
panels.description: Top 1,000 active findings ranked by NVD CVSS score, unknown scores last. Fixed version and exploitation metadata stay unknown when not supplied. Other panels count all matching records.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.cve_id AS "CVE ID", v.vulnerability_id AS "Advisory ID", v.cvss_score AS "CVSS Score", COALESCE(v.cvss_severity,'UNKNOWN') AS "CVSS Severity", a.severity AS "Wiz Severity", v.package_name AS "Package Name", v.installed_version AS "Installed Version", v.fixed_version AS "Fixed Version", a.resource_name AS "Resource Name", a.resource_type AS "Resource Type", a.subscription_name AS "Environment", a.created_at AS "Detection Date", (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - a.created_at)) / 86400.0)::double precision AS "Days Open", v.exploit_available AS "Public Exploit", v.known_exploited AS "CISA KEV", v.package_path AS "Package Path" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS') AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND a.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.cvss_severity,'UNKNOWN') IN (${cvss_severity:sqlstring}) ORDER BY v.cvss_score DESC NULLS LAST, a.created_at ASC NULLS LAST, a.id LIMIT 1000;
